settings.heading: Hello, and welcome.
settings.text:
duelokit is a small shop of gentle grief journal pages and tools. Everything here is made to be short, plain and easy to put down.

Nothing asks more of you than you have. Take what helps and leave the rest.

settings.heading: Grief is heavy enough.
settings.text: Replace this text with your own story in the theme editor: who you are, what led you to make duelokit, and who it is for.
